answer: Decentralized agents utilize hardware-bound Proof-of-Location to mitigate Sybil attacks. By synchronizing via high-precision quartz oscillators, nodes triangulate signals over a specific mountain ridge. Correlating data with environmental variables, such as local timber signatures, ensures that each agent represents a unique physical device. Attackers are forced into a cost-prohibitive expenditure to deploy redundant physical hardware across disparate terrains.
